summary: Frontend-only smoke + flow testing of the redesigned portfolio (Home, Work, Links, Guestbook, Command Menu, About, Resume). Site loads dark by default with cyan accent, no 'ar' flash, no 'Developer & Designer' under logo, hero 'Pixels. Logic. Story.' renders, /now card + meta strip + tech grid + services + marquee render without console errors. Work filters work (Web App → 4 cards), project cards expose code/live/case-study testids. Links page renders featured + around-the-web + on-site groups. Guestbook shows 'Sign the wall.' header, sticky left sign-panel with GitHub + Google buttons (both present & enabled, not clicked). Command Menu opens with Ctrl+K, shows backdrop/panel/input, 15 items across Navigate/Connect/Elsewhere/Setup, footer hints visible, Escape closes. About has 'Currently working on' block + cyan ping dot + Cinematica + AI in Digital Forensics. Resume page has new tagline and old 'Full Stack Developer & Graphics Designer' string is gone.

integration_issues.issue: 2× 401 responses observed in browser console on /guestbook (likely unauthenticated Supabase query). Page still renders 'Empty wall, fresh paint.' gracefully, but the 401s are noisy and may indicate RLS policy / anon select permissions need tightening.

issues: Selected item is not reflected via aria-selected / data-selected attributes on the cmdk-item elements — only visual ring/border. ArrowDown does change the visual highlight (verified in screenshot, Home is highlighted) but programmatic / a11y selection state is not exposed, making it harder for screen readers + automated tests to follow the selection.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate the 2× 401 errors on /guestbook — appears to be an unauthenticated Supabase read hitting RLS. Either expose a public read policy for approved guestbook entries or swallow the 401 gracefully on the client.

(Optional, minor a11y) Expose the currently-highlighted command-menu item via aria-selected="true" / data-selected on its [data-testid^="cmdk-item-"] element so screen readers + e2e tests can detect ArrowUp/Down state.

(Nit) The JSON-LD structured data in <head> still contains the string 'Full Stack Developer & Designer' in jobTitle — not visible in UI but if the goal was to scrub that phrase everywhere, this is the last place it lives.
critical_code_review_comments: Home, Work, Links, Guestbook, About, Resume all render cleanly with zero JS console errors (except the /guestbook 401 noted above).
data-testid coverage is good on hero, project cards, links cards, guestbook controls, and the command palette — automated regression testing will be easy.
Theme boot script correctly forces dark on first paint — verified document.documentElement.className === 'dark' immediately after navigation, no light-mode flash.
Work filter testids are kebab-cased (filter-web-app) while the original spec lists them title-cased (filter-Web App). The kebab-case is fine and consistent; spec is just outdated.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; 1 minor console-401 + 1 minor a11y nit

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dev server is on http://localhost:3000 (NOT the supervisor URL). Allow ~2s wait after each goto for Framer Motion animations. Guestbook entries list hits Supabase with anon key and currently returns 401 — verify after any RLS/policy changes. Command menu items don't expose aria-selected; if you need to assert keyboard nav programmatically, you'll need to either add that attribute or compare visual styles via getComputedStyle. All major data-testids in the review request resolved correctly except: filter-* uses kebab-case (filter-web-app), and links uses links-card-personal-site rather than links-card-dhruv-enhanced — none are bugs, just naming drift from the brief.
rca of the issue: Guestbook 401: client-side Supabase fetch for approved guestbook entries returns 401 — likely missing/restrictive RLS SELECT policy for the anon role on the guestbook table. Reproduce: open DevTools network tab, hit /guestbook, observe two 401s from the Supabase REST endpoint. Mitigation: add `create policy "public can read approved entries" on guestbook for select using (status = 'approved');` or equivalent, OR catch the 401 client-side and render the empty state without surfacing the network error.
